purpose: Content processing module for SMRT - handles documents, PDFs, web content, and media with AI-powered analysis capabilities.

patterns.name: Content object
patterns.description: Base content class for managing documents with metadata and AI analysis.

patterns.name: Web content mirroring
patterns.description: Download and cache content from remote URLs with automatic text extraction.
patterns.example:
const content = await collection.createFromUrl('https://example.com/article');
console.log(content.body);  // Extracted text

pitfalls: Content uses Single Table Inheritance (STI) - extend Content for custom content types
Web content extraction may require @happyvertical/spider for complex pages
